paraphrase_input: source_quote_text only; no IDs, title, dates, gold context or answer
ruri_attention_backend: torch SDPA MATH with original BF16 weights and mean pooling
corpus_scope: all families of the selected source role; query split never filters retrieval banks
history_dates: captured anchors at or before query target date
LawQA_query: original 問題文 only; no options, context or answer

fixed_bound_current_control.candidate_pool: same history-hybrid top50 addresses as the learned condition
fixed_bound_current_control.purpose: separate supervised aggregation from the additional bound-current ranking information

one_train_fit.label: candidate scoped address equals originating query address; includes unavailable target addresses
one_train_fit.candidate_scope: history-hybrid top50 aggregated addresses from TRAIN queries only

dev_selection.mix_formula: alpha times learned probability plus (1-alpha) times reranker sigmoid
dev_selection.objective: macro mean of VALID target-address MRR across query variant and available stratum
dev_selection.support_threshold: VALID top-address precision/coverage frontier; fixed before TEST
dev_selection.baseline_support_calibration: each baseline uses its own reranker sigmoid and the same empirical VALID precision target; bound baselines withhold for unavailable top ranked address

controlled_removal.scope: all available TEST queries, separately reported from natural TEST
controlled_removal.operation: one shared bank per target date: remove all available TEST gold target parents and exact NFC/whitespace-equivalent older copies of the same scoped address from both banks; make those target bindings corpus_support_unavailable
controlled_removal.older_distinct_revisions: remain available for address discovery, never hydrate the removed target
controlled_removal.interpretation: corpus support unavailable, not legal unanswerability
